parole.testo: From Classical Syriac ܡܲܦ̮ܪܝܵܢܵܐ (map̄ryānā, “one who causes to be abundant”).

parole.significato: A title of respect in Syriac, given to all saints and also used before the Christian names of bishops.
parole.testo: From Classical Syriac ܡܪܝ (mār(ī)), the first-person singular possessive form of ܡܪܐ (mārā, “lord, master”).

parole.significato: The Eucharistic service in Syrian Christianity.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Classical Syriac ܩܘܪܒܢܐ. Doublet of corban.
